objections.claim: [round 1] JSONL envelope base node {type: object, required: [schema], discriminator} cannot carry additionalProperties: false, yet the DONE walk requires it on every object node except data/effect/payload.
objections.disposition_rationale: Fixed in the spec revision after round 1

objections.claim: [round 1] Unknown names in a type array are ignored, so a typo in a published v0.3 schema silently disables that field's type check (fail-open at the schema-authoring layer).
objections.disposition_rationale: Fixed in the spec revision after round 1

objections.claim: [round 1] Four separable pieces in one complex slice; declaredEffectViolations is the only live write-path change and should be split or at least shipped as its own revertible commit.
objections.disposition_rationale: Resolved by re-slice: declaredEffectViolations split to FAFF-1262.

objections.claim: [round 1] No slice owns the parent's warn-only mint mode, so FAFF-1261 could switch on refusal with no warn period.
objections.disposition_rationale: Resolved by re-slice: warn-only mint period filed as FAFF-1263, blocks FAFF-1261.

objections.claim: [round 1] Design principle 'the only new refusal is in the effects writer' is false: the validator change tightens schemaCheck for every faff contract, and no early all-contract-schemas sweep is in HOW or DONE.
objections.disposition_rationale: Fixed in the spec revision after round 1

objections.claim: [round 1] The L4 fixture assumption check sits only in Assumptions, not in the build order, so nothing forces it before the run-ledger schema is written.
objections.disposition_rationale: Fixed in the spec revision after round 1

objections.claim: [round 1] The facade accepted_under_contract vs conformed_to_contract drift is only reported on FAFF-1255, with no ticket.
[round 1] 'Exactly 12 manifest entries' may conflict with 'every minted file has a manifest entry' if the mint copies files not in the table; the spec never enumerates the mint copy list.
objections.disposition_rationale: The mint copy list is exactly the 12 manifest entries (events.js optionalFloorFiles plus fixed files); spec now enumerates it.

objections.claim: [round 1] The pass scenario relies on the FAFF-1213 anchor holding only the listed files; the spec does not state its contents.
objections.disposition_rationale: Checked: the FAFF-1213 anchor holds exactly the seven files listed; spec now states them.

objections.claim: [round 2] DONE closure lint requires additionalProperties false on every object node, but run-ledger maps, claimed_by_peer and the manifest files map use additionalProperties as a schema.
objections.disposition_rationale: Fixed in the spec revision after round 2. Accepted by the product owner's standing fix-minors-and-build preference without a round-3 pass.

objections.claim: [round 2] validateAnchorDir marks unmanifested files fail (step 3) before the legacy check (step 4); which status wins is ambiguous.
objections.disposition_rationale: Fixed in the spec revision after round 2. Accepted by the product owner's standing fix-minors-and-build preference without a round-3 pass.
